status: Primary-source dimensional facts for candidate selection; price/shipping not quoted; delivered parts still require inspection.

pin.material: Hardened steel, blackened; bearing/shank surfaces ground

bushing.replacement_method: Press out/replace in separate steel cartridge and requalify. Not a quick-change slip bushing.

fits.note: Bushing installed ID may change after pressing; fit bound applies only after installed gauging.

locating_principle.interpretation: One round primary fixes two lateral directions; diamond secondary fixes rotation while relieving pin-pitch variation. Independent three Z contacts complete six rigid-body constraints.

aluminum.chosen_grade: New documented6061-T6 or equivalent engineering-approved stock; not assumed owned scrap
aluminum.note: Nominal elastic-property assumptions; weld heat-affected-zone strength not qualified here.

hdpe.interpretation: Wear surface only. Separate thermal freedom and compression stops; no high-precision pin bore or structural clamp datum in HDPE.
